title: Bridgefold handoff notes — rough
content:
Quick context: took the 18:00–02:00 bridge shift. Mostly quiet but a couple of small blips. This is a rough scratchpad for the next person — keep or trim as you like.

Snapshot at handoff (2026-01-04 01:45 PT):
- All active alerts: 2 WARN, 0 SEV at the moment.
  - WARN: embedding-queue-latency (p95 ~ 950ms, threshold 800ms) — started at ~22:10, spikes align with batch job 'embed-regen' runs.
  - WARN: ssd-usage-hot (node: gpu-ded-7) ~ 82% — creeping up after nightly large-model cache fill.
- Recent deploys: canary rolled forward for model-router v2.3.1 at 21:30; rollout 20% traffic, auto-fallback set. No errors so far.
- Ongoing/pending items: incident SRE-4247 (intermittent 503s hitting hosted api behind model-router) — patch PR opened (GH #1182) but not yet merged; monitoring for recurrence.

Immediate checks to run on takeover: (commands I run often)
- check alerts: ./sre-tools alert-digest --since 6h
- quick health: kubectl -n inference get pods -o wide | egrep "CrashLoop|Error|0/"
- check model-router logs (canary lane): gcloud logging read "resource.type=container AND resource.labels.cluster_name=infra-prod AND labels.router=canary" --limit 200 --freshness=1h
- tail gateway metrics: prometheus query p50/p95 for request_latency_seconds{route=~"/v1/generate|/v1/embed"}

What I observed tonight (notes + hypotheses):
- embedding-queue-latency correlated with the scheduled "embed-regen" batch job that kicks at hh:10 and hh:40. The batch's size parameter was temporarily doubled last week for a one-off backfill; likely need to revert to size=500 (ticket linked).
- gpu-ded-7 ssd usage: caused by model cache thrash when the new quantized-2b models were being pulled. I bumped eviction policy to aggressive (ttl 1h) for now to free space. Need proper quota fix in infra (ticket open).
- small 5-min spike of 503s at 23:17 — trace points to model-router hitting TCP pool exhaustion on canary instances due to a spike of retried requests from a client (id: mobile-sync-batch). I rate-limited that client at the edge for now (edge-ratelimit policy applied) and notified partner.

Notes to cover during handoff (do verbally if possible):
- embedding-queue: watch p95 for next two scheduled run windows (00:10 and 00:40). If p95 > 1.2s, temporarily scale worker pool: k scale deployment embed-worker --replicas=6 (current 4). Revert after the two runs.
- SSD on gpu-ded-7: if usage crosses 90% AND eviction doesn't free enough, put node in drain and migrate pods: kubectl cordon gpu-ded-7; kubectl drain gpu-ded-7 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force. Only do during low traffic; coordinate with infra on-call.
- model-router canary: rollback plan is in GH #1182 PR description (fast rollback via helm rollback router-canary 1). If 5xx rate > 0.5% sustained for 10m, trigger rollback.

Short commands cheat-sheet (put these in your terminal history):
- tail canary router logs: kubectl -n inference logs deploy/router-canary -c router -f --tail=200
- scale embed workers: k scale deployment embed-worker --replicas=N
- cordon + drain node: k cordon <node>; k drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
- edge rate-limit: terraform apply -var='rule=mobile-sync-batch-limit' (quick hack — revert after 2h)

Open questions / TODOs (not urgent but follow up):
- Confirm whether embed-regen should run with reduced batch size; owner on backlog is @Marco. I left a note in SRE-4247 to revert the doubled parameter.
- Figure out persistent cache strategy for quantized models — current TTL fiddles are Band-Aids. Product/infra sync next Tuesday.
- Add synthetic probe for model-router canary lane (small prompt) so we get faster signal next time.

Incidents & postmortem notes (quick):
- 2026-01-03 23:17: 5-min 503 spike. Root cause: TCP connection pool exhaustion from client retries + canary instance resource contention. Mitigation: applied edge rate-limit, scaled canary pods x2, and observed recovery. Drafted mini-incident note in SRE channel — needs triage.

Handy links (quick):
- Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/d/inference/overview
- Alert runbook (embedding): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SRE/Embedding+Queue+Runbook
- GH PR (model-router fix): https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/1182
- Pager log (where we post handoff): https://slack.redwood.ai/archives/C08SREBRIDGE/p-1702055123

Notes to self (unpolished):
- remember to remove the edge rate-limit at ~03:30 if traffic looks normal. Put a calendar reminder.
- check with infra if we can add 50GB to gpu-ded-7 EBS class to avoid future immediate drains — pinged Samira.
- if you see recurring 503s with no clear canary signal, consider switching traffic to router-stable entirely (helm rollback) rather than partial scale — do only if safe.

Sign-off: leaving monitoring on, will DM next oncall if anything pops. Good luck.

— Asha

Unsent quick checklist to add to proper runbook: (copy out later)
- define embed-regen batch size default = 500
- add canary synthetic probe
- escalate SSD quota plan to infra roadmap
- add explicit rollback audit steps to model-router PR template

End of scratch.
